title: A p7hmm `STATS` line with too few values panics
body:
`Profile::from_p7hmm` (libnail/src/structs/p7hmm.rs, the `"STATS"` arm) splits a `STATS` line on whitespace and indexes `stats[1]`, `stats[2]` and `stats[3]` with no length check.

A bare `STATS` line panics with `index out of bounds: the len is 0 but the index is 1`; the input survey on nail-d551f7 ran this. `STATS LOCAL FORWARD 1.0`, which lacks the lambda, reaches `stats[3]` the same way. That case was read from the code, not run.

## Proposal

Check the token count and return an error naming the model and the line, as `parse_cutoff` does for the `GA`, `TC` and `NC` lines.
close_reason: The STATS arm in libnail/src/structs/p7hmm.rs checks for four tokens and bails quoting the line. Committed on dev.
